item.title: Change the prize after you shake on it
item.summary: In a 1v1 game, you can swap the prize or dare any time before the game ends, as long as your friend says yes in your game chat.
item.details: Ask Murph in your game chat, or use Edit game in the app. The new prize or dare counts for the whole game. Tasks can still change until Day 1 begins, then stay as agreed.
